description: Reviewed CI ratchet deltas for intentional functionality added before the architecture snapshots were refreshed. Every allowance is exact so unrelated growth or routes still fail. The source-text allowance covers assertions that landed on main after that baseline was taken, each on a test the baseline already records, led by the #1193 entry in server/routes/sp/spGoldenCoastPhase11MonthlyCloseRoutes.test.ts pinning the shared-charge Decimal expression. They are recorded at their exact current size so any further growth still fails, and they are split backlog to be repaid, not accepted sizes.

sourceTextAssertionDelta.rationale: Every entry above the retail-wave block asserts a contract that has no behavioural surface; the four recorded on 2026-09-14 are called out at the end and do not all meet that bar. The mobile-responsive files (phase1-critical-flows, wave2-factory-floor, wave3-erp-operations) assert on Tailwind breakpoint classes and data-testid template literals: jsdom applies no CSS, so which of the mobile and desktop views is visible at a breakpoint is only expressible as source text. realtime-wave2-live-page-policy asserts the ABSENCE of polling and of a second WebSocket in live pages — an absence no request can demonstrate. proforma-capacity-concurrency-wiring asserts that every proforma-linked creation path takes the capacity lock before it writes, and that the lock is taken first; ordering inside a transaction is not observable from outside it. company-deletion-contract asserts that storage.ts composes the dependency-aware deletion service rather than a second implementation, which is a wiring fact, not a result. factory-loading-soft-delete-overload-regression asserts that soft-deleted proformas and orders are excluded from the shared capacity snapshot and that both scan and bulk-import source their counts from it; the exclusion is a SQL predicate, so there is no request that can distinguish it from a count that happens to be equal. sales-report-compact-routes verifies that every sales-report URL the build-time Vite transform emits is registered by the mounted stats registry, and that the compact routes mount before the legacy raw route; the fetched URLs only exist after the transform runs, so no dev-mode request can demonstrate the wiring. tracking-continuous-list-cleanup asserts the ABSENCE of legacy pagination controls and page state after the continuous-list migration, keeps cursor-invariant failures as internal technical identifiers, and pins the quality-doc/type-escape-ceiling synchronisation; absences and cross-file sync have no request-observable surface. The three retail-wave suites and reusable-proforma-new-loading-lifecycle landed on main already over this ceiling and are recorded here so main can certify; they are the weakest entries in this list, not exemplars. retail-wave1-contract and retail-wave2-pos-transactions pin route registrations, migration DDL and unique index names; retail-wave3-reporting-audit pins reporting SQL fragments, a schema column definition and image lazy-loading attributes; reusable-proforma-new-loading-lifecycle pins resume-state handling and asserts the ABSENCE of the removed 'Proforma fully consumed' toast. The absence assertions and the migration/index-name pins have no request-observable surface, but several of the others do - the pagination caps, the /api/retail products-page URL and the route registrations are all reachable through a request - and those should be rewritten behaviourally, which will lower this number rather than raise it. Re-measured at 274 on 2026-09-14 after main's retail ERP integration (#1476) added seven more assertions to those same suites; a pristine origin/main worktree reports the identical 2335 total, so the merge itself contributes none. maxAdditionalTextAssertions is measured exactly at 274 over the reviewed baseline of 2061, so any further growth still fails. That suite is recorded here rather than in the baseline because it is drift to be repaid, not an exemplar: the metric counters it pins are reachable through the observability endpoint and should be asserted there instead, which will lower this number. A pristine origin/main worktree reports the identical 2375 total, so the certification repair itself contributes none: its remote-support test rewrites replaced the stale ETag/SSE source assertions one for one. A pristine origin/main worktree measures the identical 2378 total and the same 138 source-coupled suites as this branch, so the certification repair contributes none of this growth; it is recorded so main can certify, and the route-registration pin is reachable through a request and should be rewritten behaviourally, which will lower this number. They are drift to be repaid, not exemplars. The repair moved one of them, stock-entry-staff-tracking-tabs, off FactoryAttendance.tsx (a god file it had newly pinned) by rendering that page in tests/ui/factory-attendance-behavior.test.tsx, which removed 36 assertions, and factory-user-restrictions now checks the Factory page catalogue through the access registry rather than sidebar source.
